title: Eval run · #36509 keep/drop · travel_expense · skill on × 5 reps · before 45ef94ef vs after e25207de · 2026-11-24
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

The keep/drop round for PR #36509 (card #34996), requested in knocks 7081825816 and 7087073505 on #33468. Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYmdC6CJJWAY54UNRCq`'s report (Sonnet orchestrator, no subagents, $1.90 nominal for the session including $1.45 of haiku ask turns); the runner made no GitHub write.

Both arms ran on one shared fixture, so this is a controlled before/after. `claims_by_status` rose from 1/5 to 2/5, which is inside 5-rep noise. The fallback-beside-a-grouping items were already at 5/5 before the change, so this card cannot show an effect there.

## Environment

- **Runner and packages:** repo `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run from two git worktrees.
  - Before: `/tmp/kd/before` at `45ef94ef2c7eaa61d4373014ef7fe2828016688a`, record `env.framework` `45ef94ef`.
  - After: `/tmp/kd/after` at `e25207de4e9c0a57179773612d30cdb5e976dffb`, record `env.framework` `e25207de`.
  - Package lines: `packages: workspace @ 45ef94ef (unreleased)` and `workspace @ e25207de (unreleased)`, 76 packages packed per arm.
- **Mode, driver and login:** ask mode only. Driver `claude-code-cli`, `claude --version` 2.1.331. Login `oauth_token`, API-billed: no, with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` unset.
- **Ask config (both arms):** `--ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --ask-repeats 5`, max 12 turns per ask. Every ask was served by `claude-haiku-5-5` (96 of 96 asks in each recording, no `⚠ asked for` flags). The scorecard `Run · model` shows `claude-haiku-5-5 ×97 · effort medium`. The 97th turn is the confirm turn of the one irreversible operation, which the scorecard counts separately.
- **Fixture, shared by both arms:**
  - Path: `/tmp/kd/fixture/travel_expense.json`, outside both worktrees, passed as `--template` to both.
  - sha256 `4ab7e603101e6adee0ede53563a13a9a830c8323d8e3f702222986042e726fd8`, from main's committed `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`.
  - I copied it from the session checkout at `57445a69`, which is a shallow clone.
  - Both records stamp `template: travel_expense.json sha256 4ab7e603…`.
  - The card stamp is `travel_expense (sha256 68eb89a981c5)` in both.
- **Fixtures at the pinned shas:** `5fe6f452d36fe56a0ecf0f8c782394076953baeb99ef2499763991e119a29989` in both worktrees, so they were equal. They could not be installed (see Scope).
- **Skill, as the runner stamps it** (the skill folder itself, `skills/objectstack-ask` at each sha):
  - before: `objectstack-ask@18.6.0`, sha256 `a195d47d555eab4c5de9be1e0c5553927d0b0e4302d5e36e64cf41542f295f2d`.
  - after: `objectstack-ask@18.6.0`, sha256 `075f7cda7a2f64dfb1fea3dbeb323febe5eb57ba0b49fe24262ffdbdd5e283e1`.
- **Preconditions:** #34911 and #34882 were both merged on 2026-11-17.
- **Build:**
  - `pnpm install` exited 0 in both worktrees.
  - The first spec build stopped on its deletion-check anchor `7eb613c3`, which the shallow clone lacked. I fetched it and rebuilt, with no code change.
  - Both builds then exited 0.
- **Cost:** nominal only, from the CLI, not billed. Details are in Results.

## Scope

- **Card:** `travel_expense`, ask mode, skill ON, two arms. `order_to_cash` was not measured, because it has no committed fixture (#34986 is open). Nothing was built from scratch.
- **Per arm:** 10 questions, which is 13 persona turns asked 5 times each (65 asks), plus 5 dataset questions asked 5 times each (25 asks), plus 6 operations asked once. Seed was 757/757 in both arms, with no refused rows. There were no Build checks, because the build was supplied.
- **Deviation, named:**
  - The dispatch asked for each sha's own `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`.
  - That first attempt was run and refused in both arms: `422 INVALID_METADATA … demotravel_approval_step … [state-machine-no-initial-states]`. No question was asked, so it is `not measured` and not counted here.
  - Both worktrees carry the lint rule, and the fixture at those shas predates #36560 (merged 2026-11-23), the fix for #36534.
  - The seat then chose one shared fixture for control: main's committed file, the same for both arms. The only variables are each sha's workspace packages and each sha's `skills/objectstack-ask` directory.
  - Everything else is as dispatched.
- **Exit codes:**
  - Shared-fixture runs, both 0: `/tmp/kd/runs2/before/exit` and `/tmp/kd/runs2/after/exit`.
  - Refused first attempt, `before`: 0. It exited 0 despite measuring nothing.
  - Refused first attempt, `after`: attempt 1 exited 1 (OOM, 137) because I ran two workspace builds at once. Attempt 2, run alone, exited 0 with the same refusal.
- **Not measured, named:**
  - Operation `pay_claim` confirmed write: 0/0, with 1 not measured, in both arms.
  - `Run · guardrails` for `injection_as_data` was not measured in `before` (no turn read the cell `as_013_1`) and passed in `after`. That is a coverage difference, not an effect of the change.
- **Reruns:** no ask was rerun to replace another, and no outlier was dropped.

## Results

Counts are pooled as numerator over denominator, with ask turns as the unit. Operations are not repeated.

| Arm | 问数 | Datasets (`Run · datasets`) | `metric-selected` | `asked-back` (rev 3) | `fallback-labelled` | Operations | Leak flags | Ask time / nominal $ |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before 45ef94ef | 56/65 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 5/6 | 0 | 23m 04s / $0.73 over 97 turns |
| after e25207de | 60/65 | 24/25 | 10/10 | 9/10 | 5/5 | 5/6 | 0 | 22m 56s / $0.72 over 97 turns |

Each arm took about 28 minutes of wall clock, including packing the workspace packages.

`Run · kinds`, copied from the scorecard:

| Arm | `Run · kinds` |
|:--|:--|
| before | count 15/15 · group_sum 11/15 · top_n 3/5 · time_range 5/5 · join 10/10 · owner_latest 3/5 · business_term 10/10 · ambiguous 10/10 · forbidden 9/10 · unanswerable 5/5 |
| after | count 15/15 · group_sum 12/15 · top_n 4/5 · time_range 5/5 · join 9/10 · owner_latest 5/5 · business_term 10/10 · ambiguous 9/10 · forbidden 10/10 · unanswerable 5/5 |

Leak flags are server-side readings: 0 on questions, 0 on dataset questions and 0 on operations, in both arms.

**Per question, k/5**

| Question (persona) | Kind | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `paid_reimbursement` (employee) | count | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `paid_reimbursement` (dept_manager) | count | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| **`claims_by_status` (dept_manager)** | group_sum | **1/5** | **2/5** |
| `top_claimants` | top_n | 3/5 | 4/5 |

| `over_standard_by_department` | join | 5/5 | 5/5 |

| `trips_by_status` (employee) | group_sum | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `trips_by_status` (finance_officer) | forbidden | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `ec_0093_waiting_on` | owner_latest | 3/5 | 5/5 |
| `department_budgets` (employee) | forbidden | 4/5 | 5/5 |
| `department_budgets` (dept_manager) | group_sum | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `recoverable_vat` | unanswerable | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `dq_expense_claims` | metric-selected | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `dq_trip_days` | metric-selected | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `dq_travel_spend` | asked-back | 5/5 | 5/5 |
| `dq_claimed_so_far` | asked-back | 5/5 | 4/5 |

The net change of +4 on the 65 asks is made up of: `claims_by_status` +1, `top_claimants` +1, `ec_0093_waiting_on` +2, `department_budgets` (employee) +1 and `sales_paid_hotel` −1.

**The items the PR targets**

| Item | before | after | What the recordings show |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `claims_by_status` (counting-head item) | 1/5 | 2/5 | The first `list_datasets` call never carried "number of claims": 0/5 in `before`, 0/5 in `after`. A pass happened only after the model retried with it (`before` rep 4, `after` reps 3 and 4). All 7 failing asks (4 before, 3 after) are which-number ask-backs on "claims", which equals two measures, so that ask-back is ruled behaviour. |
| `over_standard_by_department` (number word plus a grouping word, `no_measure`) | 5/5 | 5/5 | All 10 asks sent `over-standard lines` + `department` and got `no_measure`. The served note changed as intended. In `before` it ended "A grouping alone is no answer: ask the user which number they mean." In `after` it ends "Only when the question has no word for a thing measured, ask the user which number they mean instead." |
| `trips_by_status` (employee, finance_officer; `candidates_only` plus a grouping word) | 5/5, 5/5 | 5/5, 5/5 | Already at ceiling in `before`. |

The PR names `orders_by_status` and `receivables_aging` as its fallback-beside-a-grouping items. Both are on `order_to_cash`, which was not measured. On this card, `over_standard_by_department` and `trips_by_status` are the nearest items, and that mapping is my reading.

## Reading

1. **Verdict as data.**
   - **Noise:** I assume ±2 of 5 per item and ±4 on the 65-ask total. That comes from the untargeted items: `ec_0093_waiting_on` moved 3/5 to 5/5, and the runner skill states about ±4 per single run on the control cards.
   - **Targeted items:** `claims_by_status` improved by 1 of 5, which is within that noise. The fallback-beside-a-grouping items were already at 5/5, so there is no headroom on this card.
   - **Other items:** nothing regressed beyond 1 of 5 per item (see item 4).
   - **Total:** the 问数 total moved from 56/65 to 60/65, but only 1 of the 4 net points is on a targeted item.
2. **Counting-head example.** The step-1 example ("number of deals", not "deals") did not change first-call term lifting on `claims_by_status`. Haiku sent "claims" in 5 of 5 first calls in both arms and only sometimes corrected itself afterwards.
3. **Dataset ask-back cases.** The measure-candidate ask-back cases held on the `before` scores, except `dq_claimed_so_far`, which dropped by 1 of 5 (item 4). They are `dq_travel_spend` 5/5 → 5/5 and `dq_claimed_so_far` 5/5 → 4/5. The `after` note beside a fallback and the conditional sentence are live in the workspace build, as the over-standard note text above shows.
4. **Two lost asks in `after`, both single reps:**
   - `dq_claimed_so_far` rep 3 made two `list_datasets` calls with no `terms`, so it never matched a dataset. It then answered with figures from object queries and asked nothing back. That skips the dataset route and does not go through the changed note.
   - `sales_paid_hotel` rep 2 reached `no_measure` ("hotel spend", "paid claims") and answered with a labelled fallback figure of 27,250 where the grader expects 27,800. It was a wrong figure on the object-query fallback, not an ask-back.
5. **Not comparable to an earlier record.** No earlier record of this configuration was named to me, so I make no like-for-like comparison. A round graded at another grader revision would not be like for like: this one is `asked-back rev 3`.
6. **Pack-level caveat.** On the shared fixture, the pinned-sha fixtures were not tested. This reading is for the shared-fixture design only.

## Loss attribution

Loss is counted as asks failed in either arm, from the recordings.

- **Which-number ask-back on "claims" (`claims_by_status`):** 7 of the asks that failed. The skill lifts the counting head only on a retry.
- **`top_claimants` (before 2, after 1):** declined or incomplete answers.
- **`ec_0093_waiting_on` (before 2):** declined or missing source.
- **`department_budgets` (employee, before 1):** answered a withheld field.
- **`dq_claimed_so_far` (after 1):** skipped the dataset route, no terms (item 4).
- **`sales_paid_hotel` (after 1):** wrong figure on the labelled fallback (item 4).
- **Empty `terms` on `list_datasets`:** an observation across the recordings, not a loss. It happened in 6 of the 97 `before` asks and 8 of the 97 `after` asks, including `dq_claimed_so_far` in 1 and 3 respectively. A skill-text candidate for `domain:skills` (item 4).
- **Scoring misjudgement:** none observed.
- **Leaks:** none.

## Records

- **Shared-fixture runs:** `/tmp/kd/runs2/before/` and `/tmp/kd/runs2/after/`, each with the run record JSON, `run.log`, `run.rec.json` (97 turns) and `exit`.
- **First attempts, refused at install with each sha's own fixture:** `/tmp/kd/runs/before/`, `/tmp/kd/runs/after/` and `/tmp/kd/runs/after-attempt1-oom/`.
- **Shared fixture:** `/tmp/kd/fixture/travel_expense.json`.
- **Build logs:** `/tmp/kd/logs/`.
- **Worktrees:** `/tmp/kd/before` and `/tmp/kd/after`.
- **Location:** everything is outside the repo tree and replayable with `--driver recorded:`.
- **Not done:** I wrote nothing to GitHub, pushed nothing, opened no PR, edited no fixture and built nothing from scratch. I spawned no subagents.
